checkpoint_identity.value: SigLIP 2 B/16 at 256px maps to checkpoint file siglip2_b16_256.npz with a published download link; the README lists standard (non-NaFlex) B/16 checkpoints at 224, 256, 384, and 512.

architecture_resolution.value: Fixed-resolution variant uses the standard ViT with learned positional embedding; patch size 16 and image resolution 256, giving an image sequence length of 256 tokens.

text_tokenizer_normalization.value: Text length 64; multilingual Gemma tokenizer with vocabulary size 256k; text is transformed to lower case before tokenization.

image_preprocessing.value: The fixed-resolution variant resizes images to 256px without preserving aspect ratio (square aspect ratio), producing a 16x16 patch grid / sequence length of 256, in contrast to the aspect-preserving NaFlex path; the exact interpolation/augmentation pipeline for this evaluation is not spelled out in the local frozen sources.

imagenet1k_evaluation.value: The paper reports ImageNet-1k val zero-shot classification accuracy in Table 1 (val column, ImageNet-1k group) and names ImageNet as a benchmark, but the local sources do not specify the prompt templates, class-name construction, or scoring procedure used for the ImageNet-1k zero-shot evaluation.

coco_retrieval_evaluation.value: The paper reports COCO text-to-image and image-to-text retrieval recall@1 in Table 1 (COCO group, T->I and I->T columns), but the local sources do not specify the COCO split (e.g. 5k test), candidate set, or the scoring/matching procedure used for the retrieval evaluation.

metric_definitions.value: ImageNet-1k is reported as zero-shot classification accuracy (val), and COCO retrieval is reported as recall@1 for both text-to-image and image-to-text directions.

software_runtime.absence_search: Checked document.tex and README_siglip2.md for any statement of the big_vision code version, runtime/framework, or library dependencies used to run the zero-shot classification and COCO retrieval evaluations for the B/16 256px models; no such software/runtime specification is present (only training hardware of up to 2048 TPUv5e chips is mentioned, which does not describe the evaluation runtime).

randomness_repetition.absence_search: Checked document.tex and README_siglip2.md for any statement about random seeds, number of repeated evaluation runs, or variance/reporting protocol for the ImageNet-1k zero-shot and COCO retrieval results; none is present.

execution_readiness.notes: All six published comparison values for the fixed-resolution B/16 256px models are present in the frozen local sources: SigLIP (INet val 76.7, COCO T->I 47.4, I->T 65.1) in tables/zeroshot_main.tex L20 and SigLIP 2 (INet val 79.1, COCO T->I 53.2, I->T 69.7) in tables/zeroshot_main.tex L21 and README_siglip2.md L19. The checkpoint, architecture/resolution, tokenizer/normalization, and metric definitions are explicit or inferable, allowing the checkpoint identity and core setup to be identified. However, publication-visible material is not sufficient to fully reproduce the evaluations: the exact ImageNet-1k zero-shot protocol (prompt templates, class-name construction, scoring) and the COCO retrieval protocol (split, candidate pool, matching) are ambiguous, and the software runtime and randomness/repetition settings are missing. Hence execution is PARTIAL, and the claim's numerical comparison remains reproducible only as reported values, not as a re-runnable evaluation.
